params.columns: k UInt64, s String, n Nullable(UInt32), a Array(UInt16), l LowCardinality(String)
params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS k, hex(sipHash64(k, {seed})) AS s, if(k % 5 = 0, NULL, toUInt32(k * 13)) AS n, range(k % 4) AS a, toString(k % 97) AS l FROM numbers({rows})

description: Hold-out for the branch population on a column mix no fit case has: one Wide part (300 000 rows) of UInt64, String, Nullable(UInt32), Array(UInt16) and LowCardinality(String) columns; every substream file is a fresh blob, every small file inline.
